function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file at the given path. Returns the file content as a string.

path.description: The absolute or relative path to the file to read.

function.name: list_directory
function.description: List the files and subdirectories in a directory at the given path. Returns a list of names.

path.description: The absolute or relative path to the directory to list.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a file at the given path with the provided content. Use with caution as this will replace any existing file content.

path.description: The absolute or relative path to the file to create or overwrite.

content.description: The full content to write to the file.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Patch a file by replacing a unique substring with new text. The old_text must appear exactly once in the file to ensure the correct location is edited.

path.description: The absolute or relative path to the file to edit.

old_text.description: The exact text to find and replace. Must be unique within the file — include surrounding context if needed to make it unique.

new_text.description: The text to replace old_text with.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Execute a shell command and return its stdout, stderr, and exit code. Use for running tests, build steps, inspecting the environment, or any other shell operations.

function.name: task_complete
function.description: Signal that the task is complete. Call this when you have finished your work or can no longer make progress. Provide a summary of what was done.

status.description: DONE: task completed successfully. DONE_WITH_CONCERNS: completed but with issues worth noting. BLOCKED: cannot proceed due to an external blocker. NEEDS_CONTEXT: insufficient information to complete the task.

summary.description: A concise summary of what was accomplished, any concerns, blockers, or what context is needed.
